title: On Q3 earnings call, Nvidia Chair Harvey Jones says the board does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO (Hayden Field/The Verge)
summary: Hayden Field / The Verge: On Q3 earnings call, Nvidia Chair Harvey Jones says the board does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO — The board said it would not take additional questions on the call about Huang's departure. … Starting Nvidia's quarterly earnings call on Tuesday, new board chair Harvey Jones …
